title: Stochastic simulation and applications in finance

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply R as a programming language and random simulation
Apply Monte Carlo simulation to solve real-world problems with random outcomes
Describe and model the behavior of financial assets over time using Monte Carlo simulation
Develop skills to build, transform, and simulate real-world problems involving randomness on computers
Develop skills to build random models for the movement of basic financial assets like stocks, bonds, interest rates, etc.
Develop skills to build random models for derivative assets in the financial market such as call options, put options, and other derivatives
Develop self-learning, organizational, and group management skills, ability to synthesize issues and persuade others
Develop personal responsibility, responsibility towards the group, and build discipline in learning
Be proactive in learning, research, and group work
Be proactive in selecting issues, data, models, and computational analysis tools
Be proactive in presenting research results
